description: A job consumes explicitly selected original local files and writes a complete native result into its owned output directory.

inputs.format: turtle | nt | xml | json-ld | csv | json
inputs.role: data | table | ontology | shapes | snapshot | provenance
inputs.title: operator title

return_fields.summary: JSON-safe complete counts, native outcome and readable overview

files.role: graph | turtle | provenance | inspection | validation_report | findings | report | query_result | additions | removals | impact
files.title: readable title

rules: Use RDFLib 7.6.0 and pySHACL 0.40.1; keep engine versions in result summary.

input_paths maps each declared key to its already byte-validated original local file. No network fetch, external XML entities, remote JSON-LD context, automatic owl:imports or SPARQL FROM/SERVICE/update.
Preserve exact RDF lexical forms, datatypes, language tags and distinct source-scoped blank nodes. Keep raw source files unchanged.
Do not flatten literal and IRI terms into indistinguishable strings in structured results.
CSV mapping is explicit: URI-encode substituted values, require declared original headers, retain the raw cell and row/source provenance, and apply only declared datatype/language/IRI/null rules.
A snapshot emits graph.nt plus a Turtle representation and complete provenance. Query, comparison and validation consume that exact retained graph.
Validation emits the full native SHACL report graph and complete readable findings, uses native meta_shacl and keeps optional inference explicit. SHACL-JS and automatic imports remain off.
A limited query or impact view declares truncation and its original total when known. Retain complete native files where the result is complete.
The wrapper owns job_id, operation, generations, cancellation, file hashing, child lifecycle and final result manifest. The engine must not start child workers or rewrite application records.
